title: 儿童语音识别适配与成人语音保持的实证研究
summary: 研究儿童ASR适配同时保持成人语音性能，比较全量微调、LoRA和权重空间合并方法，覆盖阿拉伯语和英语。结果显示儿童适配必要但会损害成人性能，双语适配更稳定，权重合并可改善权衡。
summary_en: Studies child ASR adaptation while retaining adult performance across Arabic and English, comparing full fine-tuning, LoRA, and weight-space merging. Child adaptation is necessary but often degrades adult ASR; bilingual adaptation is more stable and weight merging improves the trade-off.
